description:
Genome-wide association peaks for B. napus traits from BnIR (HZAU): 135 traits from 10 GWAS studies (seed oil
fatty acids and erucic acid, glucosinolates, oil content, flowering time, plant height, branching, silique and seed
traits, cadmium, salt and other stress responses...). Each peak (adjacent 500-kb windows with p <= 1e-6) gives the
study, lead SNP with alleles, consequence, p-value, effect (beta) and variance explained, and the genes within 25 kb
of the lead SNP with their Arabidopsis best hit and Darmor-bzh v4.1 ID (= Ensembl Plants B. napus). Search by trait
words ('erucic', 'flowering'), a ZS11 region (chromosome 'A08' with start/end in bp), or gene (ZS11
BnaA08G0133900ZS, Darmor v4.1 BnaA08g11040D, Arabidopsis AGI or name such as FAE1). No arguments lists the traits.
